title: Onboarding, UX and failure-state readiness for invited non-developer testers

misleading_language_audit.method: grep over saathi-os/app, saathi-os/components and saathi-os/lib for connectivity wording, then manual review of every hit

defects.why: The flag reflects only the local Server-Sent-Events stream from the local backend (LiveProvider subscribes to ${API_BASE}/api/events/stream). On a product with no broker connectivity, no market access and no execution authority, 'Live connected' in the global chrome claimed something untrue.
defects.severity: HIGH — it appeared on every authenticated screen
defects.additional: A 'Private alpha · local only' badge was added beside it, and the segment carries data-testid="local-platform-status" so the browser certification asserts the wording.

hits_reviewed_and_left_unchanged.pattern: LIVE EXECUTION: UNAVAILABLE, NO LIVE ORDERS, LIVE TRADING NOT AUTHORIZED, NO LIVE MARKET ACCESS, NO AUTO LIVE PROMOTION, NOT LIVE-ELIGIBLE
hits_reviewed_and_left_unchanged.reason: Every remaining occurrence of 'live' is an explicit negation stating that the capability does not exist. Changing them would weaken the disclosure, not improve it.

These describe local data-source availability and synthetic offline fixtures, and are already qualified in context (e.g. 'source boundary: synthetic offline fixtures · connected=false'). None implies broker connectivity.

misleading_language_audit.residual_risk: The audit covers the SaathiOS frontend tree. Strings originating from backend payloads are rendered verbatim; the browser certification asserts the absence of a 'live connected' claim in the rendered page text as a backstop.

surfaces_delivered.composed_from: existing ui.jsx primitives (Panel, Pill, Stack, Text, Heading, Badge, EmptyState, BlockedState) — no parallel component system was created
surfaces_delivered.first_run_setup: existing /platform/onboarding surface (M60 Workstream 1) retained and reused; not duplicated
surfaces_delivered.empty_states: existing EmptyState primitive plus mission-list empty state (data-testid="missions-empty")
surfaces_delivered.evidence_and_audit_links: MissionFailureState exposes diagnostics and evidence links; the readiness page lists every evidence path in its release-package section

accessibility.method: STATIC STRUCTURAL AUDIT of the surfaces this milestone added or changed. No automated axe run and no screen-reader session was performed — the repository has no axe or jest-axe harness, and adding one was outside this milestone's scope. This result is therefore a structural check, not a full WCAG conformance claim.

checks.detail: The readiness page has exactly one interactive control, rendered by the ui.jsx Button primitive as a real <button type="button">. Links in the failure states are real <a href>. No div-with-onClick, no custom focus trap, nothing keyboard-inaccessible.
Document order matches visual order: heading, disclosure banner, human-review markers, load control, then results. No positive tabindex anywhere in the changed files.

The disclosure banner carries aria-label="Private alpha status and limitations". Every Badge renders label text, never colour alone (the ui.jsx Badge contract is 'NEVER color-only — always label + shape marker').

All colours come from the existing design tokens and the established Badge/Pill patterns, which pair colour with text in every case, so no information is conveyed by colour alone. Measured contrast ratios were not recomputed for this milestone; the tokens are unchanged from the certified predecessor.
One <h1> (page title) and <h2> for each section, via the ui.jsx Heading primitive which renders real h1..h6. No level is skipped.

The readiness page contains no form, input, textarea or select — asserted by test. Failure states carry an explicit machine-readable reason code (PERMISSION_DENIED, SESSION_REVOKED, PRIVATE_ALPHA_INVITE_ONLY) rather than a bare colour or icon.

Approval-pending and mission-running carry role="status" with aria-live="polite", so a screen reader announces a state change without interrupting. Disclosure panels use role="note". The global status bar already carried role="status" aria-live="polite".
The readiness surface is read-only and offers no destructive action. The repository's existing ConfirmDialog primitive remains the pattern for destructive actions elsewhere.

checks.check: wide content does not force horizontal page scroll
checks.detail: The checklist table is wrapped in a container with overflowX: auto, asserted by test.
The checklist uses a real <table> with a <caption>, scope="col" column headers and scope="row" row headers.

not_covered: surfaces outside the three files this milestone changed

covers: the 'Live connected' wording is gone and cannot return
local platform wording and the private-alpha badge are present
no surface implies broker connectivity, market access, account connection, execution readiness or trading
every required failure and empty state exists
aria-live, role=status and role=note are present
no credential, registration, broker or execution control is rendered
the readiness page has no input, form, textarea or mutating control
the readiness API exposes no POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE route
owner approval cannot be marked complete by automation

full_frontend_suite.note: 318 predecessor tests plus the 24 added here.

limitations: Accessibility result is a structural audit of the changed surfaces, not a WCAG conformance claim.
No automated accessibility scanner or screen-reader session was run; the repository has no such harness.
The misleading-language audit covers the frontend tree; backend-sourced strings are covered only by the browser certification's rendered-text assertion.
